name: ctao_sii_stage1
label: CTAO-SII Stage I (425/26 nm, camera PMTs, ~400 MHz)
sources: Biteau 2026-10-08, 'Stellar intensity interferometry with the CTAO' (La Palma), Stage I / Stage II table (slides 15-16, T. Hassan): QE 0.40, ~400 MHz, F 1.15, 26 nm bandpass, 1 channel; robotic narrow-band filters, raw streaming of one photodetector per camera, GPU correlator (validated on LST-1 + MAGIC)

Biteau & Luce 2024-09-13, 'Stellar Intensity Interferometry with NectarCAM on the MSTs-N', CTA-N table (slides 18, 23): normalized spectral distribution 0.91 with a 420 nm filter for a 21 deg cone; q 0.64 (LST) / 0.73 (MST)
notes: alpha from the stations' ctao_pmt (0.40), q from ctao_lst_23m (0.64) / ctao_mst_11p5m (0.73).
